name: Map_Lastwatch
author: Claude
notes: Endless Siege map (spec S35). 300x300 flat dusk hill fort, castle origin. Four cardinal lanes in a pinwheel: each runs in 40 studs off its axis, bends at r~77 and finishes 24 studs from the castle (every lane has one bend; all turns < 90 deg). Slots: 1 Castle, 6 House (3 in the 18-30 threat band at the bends, 3 safe), 5 Tower (one on the outside of each bend seeing the run + the diagonal, one NE seeing two gates), 2 Wall across the N and S runs at r=86, 1 Barracks, 1 ArcheryRange. Decor: broken rampart ring r=92 with gates where lanes pass, gate pillars with braziers, four ruined corner watchtowers (NE one whole = 'the last watch'), banners, rubble, scorched patches, cliff rim at +/-142. All raised decor is kept > 21 studs from every lane line and off every build pad. Generated by claude-tools/kn_gen_lastwatch.py (seeded).
